谢谢.literal: thank + thank = thank you (doubled for emphasis)

对不起.literal: face + not + able = sorry (unable to face you)

没关系.literal: not + relate + connection = it's OK (no connection/problem)

火车站.literal: 火 + 车 + 站 = train station

怎么样.literal: 怎 + 么 + 样 = how is it?

起床.literal: 起 + 床 = to get up

吃饭.literal: 吃 + 饭 = to eat a meal

上课.literal: 上 + 课 = to attend class

回家.literal: 回 + 家 = to go home

看电视.literal: 看 + 电 + 视 = to watch TV

打电话.literal: 打 + 电 + 话 = to phone

有点儿.literal: have + point + child = a little bit

lessons.title: Lesson 1
lessons.description: Say hello, introduce yourself, learn basic pronouns

grammar.title: Introducing yourself: 我叫…
grammar.note: 叫 (jiào) means 'to be called'. Use it to give your name. Literally: 'I am called [name].'

grammar.title: Saying who you are: 我是…
grammar.note: 是 (shì) means 'to be'. Use 是 with nouns: 我是学生 (I am a student), 我是老师 (I am a teacher).

grammar.title: Yes/No question: …吗?
grammar.note: Add 吗 (ma) to the end of any statement to turn it into a yes/no question. No word order changes needed!

sentences.en: Hello! My name is Li Hua.
I am a student. Are you a teacher?
I'm sorry!
It's OK, thank you.
Goodbye!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hello! What is your name?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Hello! My name is Wang Fang. And you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我叫李明。很高兴认识你！
dialogue.en: My name is Li Ming. Nice to meet you!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you too!

lessons.title: Lesson 2
lessons.description: Talk about your family members and ask about ages

grammar.title: Possession with 的
grammar.note: 的 (de) shows possession, like 's in English. 我的 = my, 你的 = your, 他的 = his. Between close family/friends 的 is often dropped: 我妈妈.

grammar.title: Asking ages: 几岁 / 多大
grammar.pattern: 你今年几岁？ / 你多大？
grammar.note: 几岁 is used for children. For adults use 多大. The answer: Subject + 今年 + number + 岁.

grammar.title: Stating age
grammar.note: No verb needed! Just: [person] + 今年 (this year) + [number] + 岁.

sentences.en: She is my mom.
My dad is 45 years old this year.
How many friends do you have?
My family has four people.
How old is he this year?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Is this your family?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 是的！这是我爸爸，这是我妈妈。
dialogue.en: Yes! This is my dad, this is my mom.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: How old is your dad this year?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: He is fifty years old this year.

lessons.title: Lesson 3
lessons.description: Tell the time, say dates and days of the week
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 现在几点？/ 今天几号？

grammar.title: Asking the time: 现在几点？
grammar.pattern: 现在几点？— 现在三点半。
grammar.note: 几点 = what time. 半 (bàn) = half past. 三点一刻 = quarter past three. Time comes BEFORE the verb in Chinese sentences.

grammar.title: Asking the date: 今天几号？
grammar.pattern: 今天几号？— 今天三月二十号。
grammar.note: 月 = month, 号 = day of month. Dates go from big to small: year → month → day.

grammar.title: Days of the week
grammar.pattern: 星期一，星期二，… 星期日
grammar.note: 星期 + 1–6 for Mon–Sat. Sunday is 星期日 or 星期天. 今天星期几？= What day is today?

sentences.en: What time is it now?
It is now 9:30 AM.
What day is today?
Today is Wednesday.
What is tomorrow's date?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hi! What time is it?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It is 2 PM now.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What day is today?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 今天星期四，明天是星期五。
dialogue.en: Today is Thursday, tomorrow is Friday.

lessons.title: Lesson 4
lessons.description: Order food, ask for things politely, count dishes
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 我想要… / 请给我…

grammar.title: Ordering / wanting: 想要 + noun
grammar.note: 想 (xiǎng) = would like, 要 (yào) = want/will have. Use 想要 together for polite requests. 碗 (wǎn) = bowl (measure word).

grammar.title: Polite requests: 请 + verb
grammar.note: 请 at the start makes any request polite. 给 (gěi) = give. 杯 (bēi) = cup/glass. 一杯茶 = a cup of tea.

grammar.title: Asking the price: 多少钱？
grammar.pattern: 这个多少钱？— 二十块。
grammar.note: 多少 = how much/many. 钱 = money. 块 (kuài) is the informal unit (= yuan). 二十块 = 20 yuan.

sentences.en: I want to eat rice.
Please give me a glass of water.
Do you drink tea?
How much is this apple?
I don't drink tea, I drink water.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hello! What would you like to drink?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'd like a cup of tea, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Sure. What dish would you like?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 请给我一碗米饭和一个菜。多少钱？
dialogue.en: Please give me a bowl of rice and one dish. How much?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: 35 yuan.

lessons.title: Lesson 5
lessons.description: Talk about jobs, school life and abilities

grammar.title: Ability: 会 + verb
grammar.note: 会 (huì) = know how to (learned skill). 能 (néng) = able to (physical ability or permission). 我会游泳 = I can swim (I know how). 我不能游泳 = I can't swim (e.g. injured).

grammar.title: Negation: 不 + verb
grammar.note: 不 negates present/future actions and states. Place 不 directly before the verb or adjective. 没 negates 有 and past completed actions.

grammar.title: Location: 在 + place
grammar.note: 在 (zài) = at/in/on a place. It comes before the location. 我在家 = I am at home. 他在工作 = He is working.

sentences.zh: 我是学生，我在学校学习。
sentences.en: I am a student; I study at school.
Can you speak Chinese?
I can speak a little Chinese.
The teacher is very busy.
I don't know how to write this character.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Are you a teacher or a student?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我是学生。我在学习汉语。
dialogue.en: I am a student. I am studying Chinese.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Can you speak Chinese?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, but I don't speak it very well.

lessons.title: Lesson 6
lessons.description: Ask for directions, talk about going places and transport

grammar.title: Going somewhere: 去 + place
grammar.note: 去 (qù) = to go. Put the destination right after 去. To say how you get there, add the transport before: 我坐出租车去医院。

grammar.title: Asking where: 在哪儿？
grammar.note: 哪儿 (nǎr) = where. 在 + 哪儿 asks for location. Answer: [place] 在 [location]. 医院在右边 = The hospital is on the right.

grammar.title: From … to …: 从…到…
grammar.note: 从 (cóng) = from, 到 (dào) = to. This pattern shows the starting and ending point of travel.

sentences.en: Where are you going?
I'm going to the train station.
Where is the hospital?
I'll go by taxi.
Is it far from here to school?
Go from Beijing to Shanghai by airplane.
Where is the shop?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Where are you going?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我去医院。你知道医院在哪儿吗？
dialogue.en: I'm going to the hospital. Do you know where it is?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 知道。你可以坐出租车去，很快。
dialogue.en: Yes. You can take a taxi, it's very fast.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: OK, thank you!

lessons.title: Lesson 7
lessons.description: Describe weather and express how you feel
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 天气怎么样？/ 很+adj

grammar.title: Describing with 很 + adjective
grammar.pattern: 天气很热。/ 我很高兴。
grammar.note: 很 (hěn) = very. In Chinese, adjectives need a degree word. Without one, the sentence implies comparison. 很好 = very good / good (neutral).

grammar.title: Too much: 太 + adj + 了
grammar.note: 太…了 = too … (excessively). 了 at the end adds emphasis. Common: 太好了！(That's great!) 太忙了！(Way too busy!)

grammar.title: How is it?: 怎么样
grammar.pattern: 天气怎么样？— 很好，不冷不热。
grammar.note: 怎么样 (zěnmeyàng) = how is it? / what's it like? A versatile question word for opinions and descriptions.

sentences.en: How is the weather today?
Today is very hot, too hot!
I am very tired and also very busy.
Will the weather be good tomorrow?

sentences.zh: 他不高兴，因为天气不好。
sentences.en: He is not happy because the weather is bad.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: How is the weather today?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It's too hot! Don't you feel hot?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Yes, very hot. Are you busy today?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Very busy, and also very tired.

lessons.title: Lesson 8
lessons.description: Count, shop and talk about prices in Chinese
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 多少钱？/ 我要买…

grammar.title: Have / Don't have: 有 / 没有
grammar.note: 有 (yǒu) = to have. Its negative is 没有 (méiyǒu) — NOT 不有. This is the only verb negated with 没 in its regular form.

grammar.title: Measure words: 个, 件, 本
grammar.pattern: 一个苹果 / 两件衣服 / 三本书
grammar.note: Chinese uses measure words between numbers and nouns. 个 is general. 件 (jiàn) for clothes/matters. 本 (běn) for books. Never just '一书'!

grammar.title: Comparison: A 比 B + adj
grammar.note: 比 (bǐ) = than. Structure: A 比 B + adjective. To say 'not as … as': A 没有 B + adj. No 很 with 比!

sentences.en: How much is this piece of clothing?
150 yuan.

sentences.zh: 太贵了！有便宜一点儿的吗？
sentences.en: Too expensive! Is there something cheaper?
I want to buy two apples.
This one is better than that one.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hello! How much is this piece of clothing?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: 200 yuan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 太贵了！便宜一点儿，好吗？
dialogue.en: Too expensive! A little cheaper, OK?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: OK, 180 yuan, how about that?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK, I'll buy this one. Thank you!

lessons.title: Lesson 9
lessons.description: Describe your daily schedule from morning to night

grammar.title: Sequence: 先…然后…
grammar.note: 先 (xiān) = first, 然后 (ránhòu) = then/after that. Use this structure to describe actions in order. 然后 is an HSK 2 preview word but very useful here.

grammar.title: Frequency: 每天 + verb
grammar.note: 每天 (měitiān) = every day. Place time expressions BEFORE the verb. 每天早上 = every morning. Pattern: Subject + 每天 + time + verb.

grammar.title: Time + verb word order
grammar.note: Chinese time expressions come before the verb (opposite to English). 早上 (morning) → 八点 (8 o'clock) → 上课 (attend class). Always big-to-small: day → time → verb.

sentences.en: I get up at 7 o'clock every day.
I eat first, then go to school.
After class, I go home.

sentences.zh: 晚上我看电视或者打电话。
sentences.en: In the evening I watch TV or make calls.
I go to sleep at 11 PM.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What time do you get up every day?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我每天早上六点半起床。
dialogue.en: I get up at 6:30 AM every day.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: That early! What time does class start?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 八点上课。我先吃早饭，然后去学校。
dialogue.en: Class starts at 8. I eat breakfast first, then go to school.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What time do you sleep at night?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: 10:30, I'm very tired!

lessons.title: Lesson 10
lessons.description: Talk about what you love, like and don't enjoy

grammar.title: Expressing likes: 喜欢 + verb/noun
grammar.pattern: 我喜欢看电影。/ 我喜欢音乐。
grammar.note: 喜欢 (xǐhuan) = to like. Follow with a verb or noun. 爱 (ài) = to love (stronger). 我爱唱歌 = I love singing. No extra particle needed between 喜欢 and the verb.

grammar.title: Mild negation: 不太 + adj/verb
grammar.note: 不太 (bú tài) = not very / not really. Softer than 不. 不太好 = not very good. 不太喜欢 = don't really like. Much more natural than a blunt 不喜欢 in conversation.

grammar.title: 也 and 都 with multiple subjects
grammar.pattern: 我喜欢音乐，他也喜欢。/ 我们都喜欢。
grammar.note: 也 (yě) = also (for one additional subject). 都 (dōu) = all/both (for multiple subjects together). 也 and 都 always come BEFORE the verb.

sentences.en: What hobbies do you have?

sentences.zh: 我喜欢听音乐和看电影。
sentences.en: I like listening to music and watching movies.
I don't really like sports.
He also likes singing.
We all like reading books.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What sports do you like?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢游泳，也喜欢跑步。你呢？
dialogue.en: I like swimming and also running. And you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我不太喜欢运动。我喜欢看电影。
dialogue.en: I don't really like sports. I like watching movies.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我也喜欢看电影！我们一起去吧！
dialogue.en: I like watching movies too! Let's go together!

lessons.title: Lesson 11
lessons.description: Describe how you feel and talk to a doctor
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 有点儿… / 哪里不舒服？

grammar.title: Feeling unwell: 有点儿 + adj
grammar.pattern: 我有点儿不舒服。/ 我有点儿累。
grammar.note: 有点儿 (yǒudiǎnr) = a little / somewhat (used before negative or undesirable adjectives). 有点儿冷 = a little cold. Unlike 一点儿, 有点儿always comes BEFORE the adjective.

grammar.title: Asking what's wrong: 哪里不舒服？
grammar.pattern: 你哪里不舒服？— 我头很疼。
grammar.note: 哪里 (nǎlǐ) = where. 不舒服 = not comfortable / unwell. 疼 (téng) = to hurt/ache (HSK 2 preview). Doctors use this question; the answer names the body part.

grammar.title: Should / need to: 要 + verb
grammar.note: 要 (yào) here = should / need to (advice). 你要多喝水 = You should drink more water. 我要去医院 = I need to go to the hospital. Context makes 要 mean 'want', 'will' or 'should'.

sentences.zh: 你好吗？你看起来不太好。
sentences.en: Are you OK? You don't look very well.
I'm feeling a little unwell.
Where does it hurt / what's wrong?

sentences.zh: 我头很疼，也有点儿发烧。
sentences.en: My head hurts a lot and I have a slight fever.
You should go to the hospital to see a doctor.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你怎么了？你看起来不舒服。
dialogue.en: What's wrong? You look unwell.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我有点儿发烧，头也很疼。
dialogue.en: I have a slight fever and my head hurts a lot.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: You need to go to the hospital to see a doctor!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 好，但是我不知道医院在哪儿。
dialogue.en: OK, but I don't know where the hospital is.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'll go with you! The hospital isn't far.

lessons.title: Lesson 12
lessons.description: Describe people and things using colors and adjectives

grammar.title: Adjective + 的 + noun
grammar.pattern: 红色的衣服 / 漂亮的老师
grammar.note: To use an adjective before a noun, add 的 between them. 红色的 = red (one). 漂亮的学生 = a beautiful student. Single-syllable adj usually drop 的: 大书 (big book), 好人 (good person).

grammar.title: Superlative: 最 + adjective
grammar.pattern: 这件衣服最漂亮。/ 他最高。
grammar.note: 最 (zuì) = most / -est. Place 最 directly before any adjective. 最好 = best. 最大 = biggest. 最贵 = most expensive. Much simpler than English superlatives!

grammar.title: Same as: 一样
grammar.note: 一样 (yīyàng) = the same / alike. Pattern: A 和 B 一样 + adj = A is as [adj] as B. 这个和那个一样贵 = This is as expensive as that. Opposite: 不一样 = different.

sentences.en: What color do you like?
I like red.

sentences.zh: 这件红色的衣服很漂亮。
sentences.en: This red piece of clothing is very beautiful.
Which piece of clothing is the most expensive?

sentences.zh: 这两个一样大，但是颜色不一样。
sentences.en: These two are the same size, but different colors.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你觉得哪件衣服最漂亮？
dialogue.en: Which piece of clothing do you think is the most beautiful?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I think the red one is the most beautiful!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢白色的。这两件一样贵吗？
dialogue.en: I like the white one. Are these two the same price?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 不一样。红色的比白色的便宜。
dialogue.en: No. The red one is cheaper than the white one.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK, then I'll buy the red one!

lines.en: He is a teacher.
The teacher is called Wang Fang.
She is a student, she is called Li Hua.
Thank you, teacher!
The teacher says: You're welcome, goodbye.

questions.question: 谁是老师？
questions.questionEn: Who is the teacher?

questions.question: 李华是学生。
questions.questionEn: Li Hua is a student.

lines.en: My name is Chen Ming.
I am a student.
My teacher is called Teacher Li.
She is very good.
I am also very happy to know her.

questions.question: 陈明是老师。
questions.questionEn: Chen Ming is a teacher.

questions.question: 陈明的老师叫什么？
questions.questionEn: What is Chen Ming's teacher called?

lines.en: There are three people in my family.
Dad, mom and me.
My dad is 45 years old this year.
My mom is 40 years old this year.

questions.question: 他家有四个人。
questions.questionEn: His family has four people.

questions.question: 妈妈今年多大？
questions.questionEn: How old is mom this year?

readings.title: 你家有几个人？
readings.titleEn: How Many People in Your Family?

lines.en: How many people are in your family?

lines.zh: 我家有四个人。爸爸、妈妈、姐姐和我。
lines.en: My family has four people. Dad, mom, older sister and me.
How old is your dad this year?

lines.zh: 他今年五十岁。我妈妈四十八岁。
lines.en: He is fifty this year. My mom is 48.

questions.question: 他家有几个人？
questions.questionEn: How many people are in his family?

questions.question: 他爸爸今年五十岁。
questions.questionEn: His dad is fifty years old this year.

lines.en: What time is it now?
It is 9:30 AM now.
What day is today?

lines.zh: 今天星期三。明天是星期四。
lines.en: Today is Wednesday. Tomorrow is Thursday.
What is tomorrow's date?
Tomorrow is March 20th.

questions.question: 现在几点？
questions.questionEn: Wbat time is it now?

questions.question: 今天是星期四。
questions.questionEn: Today is Thursday.

questions.question: 明天是几月几号？
questions.questionEn: What is tomorrow's date?

lines.en: Today is Monday.
At 8 AM I go to school.
At noon I eat lunch.
In the afternoon I go home.

questions.question: 今天是星期二。
questions.questionEn: Today is Tuesday.

questions.question: 他几点去学校？
questions.questionEn: What time does he go to school?

lines.en: I want to eat rice.
Do you want to drink tea?
I don't drink tea, I want water.
How much are these dishes?

questions.question: 他想喝什么？
questions.questionEn: What does he want to drink?

questions.question: 他想吃米饭。
questions.questionEn: He wants to eat rice.

lines.en: I really like eating Chinese food.
I eat rice every day.
I also like drinking tea.
But I don't like drinking water.
I like eating apples the most.

questions.question: 他喜欢喝水。
questions.questionEn: He likes drinking water.

questions.question: 他最喜欢吃什么？
questions.questionEn: What does he like eating the most?

lines.zh: 我是学生，我在学校学习。
lines.en: I am a student, I study at school.
I can speak Chinese.
My teacher is called Li Ming.
He can write many Chinese characters.

questions.question: 李明是谁？
questions.questionEn: Who is Li Ming?

questions.question: 李明不会写汉字。
questions.questionEn: Li Ming cannot write characters.

lines.en: Can you speak Chinese?

lines.zh: 会，但是我说得不太好。我在学习。
lines.en: Yes, but I don't speak it very well. I am studying.
Where do you study Chinese?

lines.zh: 我在学校学习。我的老师很好。
lines.en: I study at school. My teacher is very good.
Can you write Chinese characters?
I can write a little, not too many.

questions.question: 他的汉语说得很好。
questions.questionEn: He speaks Chinese very well.

questions.question: 他在哪里学习汉语？
questions.questionEn: Where does he study Chinese?

lines.en: Hello! I need to go to the hospital.
Where is the hospital?

lines.zh: 医院不远，你可以坐出租车去。
lines.en: The hospital is not far, you can take a taxi.
OK. How much is the taxi?
About 20 yuan.

questions.question: 他要去哪儿？
questions.questionEn: Where does he want to go?

questions.question: 医院很远。
questions.questionEn: The hospital is very far.

questions.question: 他怎么去医院？
questions.questionEn: How does he go to the hospital?

lines.en: My home is in Beijing.
My school is also in Beijing.
From home to school is not far.

lines.zh: 我每天坐出租车去学校。
lines.en: I take a taxi to school every day.

questions.question: 他家不在北京。
questions.questionEn: His home is not in Beijing.

questions.question: 他怎么去学校？
questions.questionEn: How does he go to school?

lines.en: How is the weather today?
Today is very hot, too hot!
Are you happy?

lines.zh: 不太高兴，因为天气太热了，我很累。
lines.en: Not very happy, because the weather is too hot and I am very tired.
Tomorrow will be a little cooler.

questions.question: 今天天气怎么样？
questions.questionEn: How is the weather today?

questions.question: 他今天很高兴。
questions.questionEn: He is very happy today.

questions.question: 他为什么不高兴？
questions.questionEn: Why is he not happy?

lines.en: Today I am very busy and also very tired.
The weather is also not good, too cold.

lines.zh: 但是明天天气很好，我很高兴！
lines.en: But tomorrow the weather will be very good, I am happy!

questions.question: 今天天气很好。
questions.questionEn: The weather is very good today.

questions.question: 明天天气怎么样？
questions.questionEn: How is the weather tomorrow?

lines.en: How much is this piece of clothing?
200 yuan.

lines.zh: 太贵了！便宜一点儿，好吗？
lines.en: Too expensive! A little cheaper, OK?
OK, 150 yuan, how about that?
OK, I'll buy this one. Thank you!

questions.question: 衣服最后多少钱？
questions.questionEn: What was the final price of the clothes?

questions.question: 他觉得两百块不贵。
questions.questionEn: He thinks 200 yuan is not expensive.

lines.en: Today I go to the shop to buy things.

lines.zh: 我买了两件衣服和三个苹果。
lines.en: I bought two pieces of clothing and three apples.
The clothes cost 100 yuan in total.
The apples are very cheap, 5 yuan in total.

lines.zh: 我没有很多钱，但是我很高兴！
lines.en: I don't have much money, but I am very happy!

questions.question: 他买了几件衣服？
questions.questionEn: How many pieces of clothing did he buy?

questions.question: 苹果很贵。
questions.questionEn: The apples are very expensive.

lines.zh: 我每天早上六点半起床。
lines.en: I get up at 6:30 AM every day.

lines.zh: 我先吃早饭，然后去学校。
lines.en: I eat breakfast first, then go to school.
Class ends at 3 PM, I go home.

lines.zh: 晚上我看电视或者打电话。
lines.en: In the evening I watch TV or make phone calls.
I go to sleep at 10 PM.

questions.question: 他几点起床？
questions.questionEn: What time does he get up?

questions.question: 他先去学校，然后吃早饭。
questions.questionEn: He goes to school first, then eats breakfast.

questions.question: 他几点睡觉？
questions.questionEn: What time does he go to sleep?

readings.title: 你每天几点睡觉？
readings.titleEn: What Time Do You Sleep Every Day?

lines.en: What time do you get up every day?
I get up at 7 every day. And you?

lines.zh: 我六点半起床。我先吃饭，然后上课。
lines.en: I get up at 6:30. I eat first, then attend class.
What time do you go to sleep?

lines.zh: 晚上十一点。我每天很累！
lines.en: 11 PM. I am very tired every day!

questions.question: A 每天几点起床？
questions.questionEn: What time does A get up every day?

questions.question: B 先上课，然后吃饭。
questions.questionEn: B attends class first, then eats.

lines.en: I have many hobbies.

lines.zh: 我喜欢听音乐和看电影。
lines.en: I like listening to music and watching movies.

lines.zh: 我也喜欢运动，我每天早上跑步三十分钟。
lines.en: I also like sports; I run for thirty minutes every morning.

lines.zh: 星期六下午，我和朋友去游泳。
lines.en: On Saturday afternoons, I go swimming with my friends.

lines.zh: 但是我不太喜欢唱歌，我唱歌不好听。
lines.en: But I don't really like singing; my singing doesn't sound good.

lines.zh: 晚上我在家看书，也看电视。
lines.en: In the evening I read books at home, and also watch TV.

lines.zh: 我觉得有爱好的人每天都很高兴。
lines.en: I think people with hobbies are happy every day.

questions.question: 他每天什么时候跑步？
questions.questionEn: When does he run every day?

questions.question: 星期六下午他和朋友去游泳。
questions.questionEn: On Saturday afternoon he goes swimming with friends.

questions.question: 他为什么不太喜欢唱歌？
questions.questionEn: Why doesn't he really like singing?

questions.question: 这个故事主要说什么？
questions.questionEn: What is this story mainly about?

lines.en: What hobbies do you have?

lines.zh: 我喜欢看电影和听音乐。你呢？
lines.en: I like watching movies and listening to music. And you?

lines.zh: 我喜欢运动。我们都喜欢看书吗？
lines.en: I like sports. Do we both like reading books?
I like reading books, and you?

lines.zh: 我不太喜欢看书。我更喜欢运动。
lines.en: I don't really like reading. I prefer sports.

lines.zh: 那星期六我和你一起去跑步，好吗？
lines.en: Then how about I go running with you on Saturday?

lines.zh: 好！我们跑步，然后去看电影。
lines.en: Great! We'll go running, and then go see a movie.

lines.zh: 太好了！我们星期六上午见！
lines.en: Wonderful! See you Saturday morning!

questions.question: A 很喜欢看书。
questions.questionEn: A really likes reading books.

questions.question: B 喜欢什么？
questions.questionEn: What does B like?

questions.question: 他们星期六上午做什么？
questions.questionEn: What will they do on Saturday morning?

questions.question: A 和 B 的爱好不太一样，但是他们想一起做。
questions.questionEn: A and B have rather different hobbies, but they want to do things together.

lines.zh: 你怎么了？你看起来不太好。
lines.en: What's wrong? You don't look very well.

lines.zh: 我有点儿不舒服。头很疼，眼睛也疼。
lines.en: I feel a little unwell. My head hurts a lot, and my eyes hurt too.

lines.zh: 你发烧了吗？昨天晚上睡觉了吗？
lines.en: Do you have a fever? Did you sleep last night?

lines.zh: 有点儿发烧。昨天我工作到晚上十二点。
lines.en: A slight fever. Yesterday I worked until midnight.

lines.zh: 你太累了！你要去医院看医生。
lines.en: You're too tired! You need to go to the hospital to see a doctor.
But I'm very busy this afternoon.

lines.zh: 看医生最重要！我和你一起去。
lines.en: Seeing a doctor is the most important thing! I'll go with you.
OK, thank you.

questions.question: 他哪里不舒服？
questions.questionEn: Where does he feel unwell?

questions.question: 他没有发烧。
questions.questionEn: He does not have a fever.

questions.question: 他为什么不舒服？
questions.questionEn: Why does he feel unwell?

questions.question: 朋友为什么说“我和你一起去”？
questions.questionEn: Why does the friend say "I'll go with you"?

readings.title: 我去看医生
readings.titleEn: I Go to See the Doctor

lines.en: Yesterday I felt a little unwell.

lines.zh: 我头很疼，也有点儿发烧。
lines.en: My head hurt a lot and I had a slight fever.

lines.zh: 早上我没有吃饭，也不想去上课。
lines.en: In the morning I didn't eat, and didn't want to go to class.

lines.zh: 妈妈说：“你要去医院看医生。”
lines.en: Mom said, "You need to go to the hospital to see a doctor."

lines.zh: 下午我和妈妈坐出租车去医院。
lines.en: In the afternoon Mom and I took a taxi to the hospital.

lines.zh: 医生说我要多喝水，多休息，晚上早点儿睡觉。
lines.en: The doctor said I should drink more water, rest more, and go to bed early at night.

lines.zh: 今天我好多了，我能去学校上课了！
lines.en: Today I'm much better, and I can go to school for class!

questions.question: 他昨天早上去上课了。
questions.questionEn: He went to class yesterday morning.

questions.question: 他们怎么去医院？
questions.questionEn: How did they get to the hospital?

questions.question: 医生说他要做什么？
questions.questionEn: What did the doctor say he should do?

questions.question: 今天他为什么能去上课？
questions.questionEn: Why can he go to class today?

readings.title: 哪件最漂亮？
readings.titleEn: Which One Is the Most Beautiful?

lines.zh: 你觉得哪件衣服最漂亮？
lines.en: Which piece of clothing do you think is the most beautiful?

lines.zh: 我觉得红色的最漂亮！你呢？
lines.en: I think the red one is the most beautiful! And you?

lines.zh: 我喜欢白色的。这两件一样贵吗？
lines.en: I like the white one. Are these two the same price?

lines.zh: 不一样。红色的比白色的便宜一百块。
lines.en: No. The red one is 100 kuai cheaper than the white one.

lines.zh: 黑色的怎么样？黑色的也很漂亮。
lines.en: How about the black one? The black one is also very pretty.
The black one is too big, and it's the most expensive too.

lines.zh: 好，那我买红色的！红色的便宜，也很漂亮。
lines.en: OK, then I'll buy the red one! The red one is cheap and also very pretty.

questions.question: B 觉得哪件衣服最漂亮？
questions.questionEn: Which clothing does B think is the most beautiful?

questions.question: 红色的衣服比白色的贵。
questions.questionEn: The red clothing is more expensive than the white one.

questions.question: 为什么不买黑色的？
questions.questionEn: Why not buy the black one?

questions.question: A 最后为什么买红色的？
questions.questionEn: Why does A buy the red one in the end?

lines.zh: 今天我买了一件新衣服。
lines.en: Today I bought a new piece of clothing.
It is red and very beautiful.

lines.zh: 我的旧衣服是黑色的，有点儿小了。
lines.en: My old clothes are black and have gotten a little small.

lines.zh: 这件衣服比我的旧衣服漂亮多了。
lines.en: This clothing is much more beautiful than my old clothes.

lines.zh: 这件衣服不太贵，两百块。
lines.en: This clothing isn't too expensive: two hundred kuai.

lines.zh: 我妈妈说这件是我们家最漂亮的衣服！
lines.en: My mom says this is the most beautiful piece of clothing in our home!

lines.zh: 明天星期六，我要和朋友去饭店吃饭。
lines.en: Tomorrow is Saturday, and I'm going to a restaurant with friends.

lines.zh: 我想朋友们也会说这件衣服很漂亮。
lines.en: I think my friends will also say this clothing is very beautiful.

questions.question: 新衣服多少钱？
questions.questionEn: How much was the new clothing?

questions.question: 新衣服没有旧衣服漂亮。
questions.questionEn: The new clothing is not as beautiful as the old one.

questions.question: 他为什么买新衣服？
questions.questionEn: Why did he buy new clothing?

questions.question: 他很喜欢他的新衣服。
questions.questionEn: He really likes his new clothing.
